items.title: Novelist accused of using AI to write book removed from French prize list
items.excerpt: Thélyson Orélien's debut was dropped from the Prix Goncourt list after AI-authorship claims spread on social media. NOTE: follow-up to the 09-24 Bookseller accusation card; only pick if framed as the new prize-removal development.

items.title: We Don't Want Shonen Jump AI Manga Translations
items.excerpt: Shueisha appears to be surveying MANGA Plus readers on AI translation, a sign it is weighing machine-translated manga releases; the piece argues MT can't replace human localization.

items.title: EWC denounces AI Tech's practice of shredding books and calls on Europe's decision-makers to take a firm stand
items.excerpt: The EWC condemns AI firms' 'destructive scanning' of millions of old and rare European books for training data and calls on policymakers to act for authors, publishers and readers.

items.title: 일본 헌책방 매출 5배 증가…AI 학습용으로 50톤이 미국행, 스캔 뒤 폐기
items.excerpt: 일본 헌책방 매출이 최대 5배 늘었다. 2022년 이전 출간 도서를 톤 단위로 사들여 50톤 넘게 미국으로 수출, AI 학습용으로 스캔한 뒤 폐기하는 흐름이다. (same story cluster as EWC shredding item)

items.title: Storytel launched AI-generated audiobook recaps in Finland without telling authors
items.excerpt: Storytel's AI 'Recaps' summarise the last 5-15 minutes of an audiobook; Finnish author Suvi Auvinen and the Writers' Union object that authors weren't notified and AI summaries can distort works. Storytel says publishers got a month's notice and an opt-out. (Finnish-language article)

items.title: Apex CoVantage to Launch eden, an AI-Powered Editorial Engine for Publishing, at Frankfurt Book Fair
items.excerpt: Apex CoVantage will debut eden, an AI editorial engine for book and academic publishing that flags subject-aware errors and speeds copyediting while keeping editors in charge, at Frankfurt on Oct 7.

items.title: OpenAI 'trained models' on books from 'sketchy AF' LibGen, unsealed court filings reveal
items.excerpt: Unsealed filings show OpenAI staff discussed training early GPT models on LibGen books, debated how to describe the source publicly and weighed the cost of buying books instead. NOTE: overlaps PW unsealed-files card (09-22) and Jane Friedman's 'OpenAI's piracy worse than Anthropic's' (09-23).

items.title: The FLIP tackles disinformation in publishing event featuring Sarah Wynn-Williams and Joanna Prior
items.excerpt: Female Leadership in Publishing held an event at Pan Macmillan on mis- and disinformation in the age of AI. (weak AI angle)

items.title: 'My boomer mom made a whole AI book for both of my kids' — the bizarre rise of 'grandmaslop'
items.excerpt: Grandparents are using AI to make personalised picture books and images of their grandchildren, and many parents hate it. (off-list; AI personalised children's book angle)

items.title: Getting Out of Writer's Block (Ft. New Novelcrafter Organization Update!) - Novelcrafter Live
items.excerpt: Novelcrafter livestream testing new AI models for drafting past writer's block and showing the app's new manuscript organisation options.

items.title: "내가 바로 웹툰 주인공"⋯네이버웹툰 AI 캐릭터챗으로 만드는 새 이야기
items.excerpt: 네이버웹툰의 AI 스토리챗 '바이어스(byUs)'가 출시 10주 만에 누적 대화 1400만건을 돌파. 작가가 승인·검수한 IP 설정 위에서 독자가 주인공이 돼 2차 서사를 만들고, 원작 조회수도 67% 늘었다.

items.title: 가상융합산업허브 입주 결실…AI·글로벌 음향 결합 오디오북 시장 개척
items.excerpt: 사운드그랩·보이스그랩이 영화급 사운드 믹싱과 AI 보이스 기술을 결합한 '하이브리드 시네마 오디오북' 솔루션을 출시한다.
